brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have prevented two European Parliament members from Sweden's Left Party, Jonas Sjöstedt and Hanna Gadén, from entering occupied Palestinian territories, Shehab Wire reported. The ban came at the request of Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar and marks an apparent response to the lawmakers' public criticism of Israeli military conduct.

Sjöstedt and Gadén are members of the Swedish Left Party delegation to the European Parliament and have been vocal critics of Israeli operations in Gaza. The decision to bar them represents an escalation in restrictions on foreign officials deemed critical of Israeli government policies. Israeli authorities have not released a formal statement outlining specific grounds for the entry prohibition beyond Sa'ar's directive to implement the ban.
